title: Mark the hot spots yellow on `Editing`
text: Mark the hot spots yellow on `Editing`, not just the question colours: the loud arguments (raised voices, people talking over each other), the clash, the admissions, the lines the story can't lose. Mark the closing lines orange. Yellow is the must-keep list for the YT and the pool for the hook and highlight. Use the audio level to find the loud stretches, then listen to each one. On 20261125 I coloured only per question and marked no yellow at all.
